heading.title: Procedure in Relation to Children in Need of Care and Protection

article.title: Offence of non-reporting.
article.content:
33Offence of non-reporting.

Section 33  ·  Chapter VI  ·  page 24 of the Act
If information regarding a child as required under section 32 is not given within the period specified in the said section, then, such act shall be regarded as an offence.
